summary: GFL Environmental Inc., a NYSE/TSX-listed North American environmental services company, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its Montreal-East Material Recovery Facility won the NWRA 2026 Recycling Facility of the Year award. The item is an operational and reputational announcement, noting the 23-acre eco-hub, 120,000-square-foot single-stream MRF, and capacity of up to 220,000 tons, approximately 25% of Quebec curbside recycling volume. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are involved. There is no deal term, structural, regulatory, or arbitrage angle to watch.
